On October 17, 2026, following review of topline results from LUCIA, the second pivotal Phase 3 clinical trial evaluating DURAVYU™ for the treatment of wet age-related macular degeneration (wet AMD), the Board of Directors of the Company approved a strategic prioritization plan (the “Prioritization”) designed to reduce operating expenses and focus resources on the Company’s late-stage program for DURAVYU™ in diabetic macular edema (DME).
